description: Na₃ErV₂O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ErO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.89 Å. Er is bonded to six O atoms to form ErO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Er-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.28 Å. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent ErO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-64°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.77 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Er, and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Er, and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Er, and one V atom.
